Name & street address of site; boundary lines of district
Highland Park; bounded by Center Street, Marcella Street, Washington Street, and Roxbury Street
Basis on which eligibility might be based
Historic center of Roxbury, contains examples of earliest settlements, as well as of succeeding periods; area contains perhaps the widest range of 19th century housing in the City, including Greek Revival, Federal, Colonial, Mansard, Victorian, High Gothic, and Italianate. Currently the Roxbury Action Program and the Afro-American Historical Museum are awaiting urban renewal funds for a large-scale effort. The Massachusetts Historical Commission has allocated a percentage of a $214,796 grant to Boston, to be spent in the Highland Park area.
